atoms.b: The Burj Khalifa is the tallest skyscraper in the world. It is 828 ((metres)) tall and has 163 floors. That means it is twice as tall as the Empire State Building and almost three times as tall as the Eiffel Tower. The construction of the Burj Khalifa started in 2004 and was finished in 2009. It has been open to the public since 2010. The construction cost around one billion euros. The Burj Khalifa is located in Dubai, a city in the United Arab Emirates. Visitors can have an incredible view of the city from two observation decks. One of them, which is called At the Top, is on the 124th floor. The other one, namely At the Top Sky, is on the 148th floor. The Burj Khalifa also houses a hotel, flats, offices and shops.
